title: Design: the Change Prices and Save the General Matrix dialogs
custom_preconds:
Preconditions

  • Sign in as an Admin whose role has 'Settings — Parts' and 'See Financial Data'.
  • Have a new matrix for this test, matrix A, pricing two new categories made for this test.
  • Note the General Matrix's Default value in its first range, to put it back.
  • Use a desktop browser window exactly 1440 pixels wide, at 100% zoom, so the screen matches the design pictures' size.
custom_steps:
1. Click the Matrices tab on Settings › Pricing.
  2. Click matrix A's name.
  3. Click Edit.
  4. Type a new value in Default's first range.
  5. Click Save.
  6. Click Cancel in the dialog.
  7. Open the General Matrix from the Matrices list.
  8. Click Edit.
  9. Type a new value in Default's first range.
  10. Click Save.
  11. Click Cancel in the dialog.
custom_expected:
Expected Result

Step 1:

  • The Matrices list shows.

Step 2:

  • Matrix A's page opens.

Step 3:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 4:

  • The bar reads 1 change.

Step 5:

  • A dialog titled "Change Prices in 2 Categories?" lists the categories as bullets with Cancel (white) and Change All (blue), as in picture 3.13.

Step 6:

  • The dialog closes; the grid stays in edit.

Step 7:

  • The General Matrix page opens.

Step 8:

  • The grid is in edit.

Step 9:

  • The bar reads 1 change.

Step 10:

  • A dialog titled "Save the General Matrix?" opens.
  • It lists the first category names and ends with a blue "+" count for the rest, with Cancel and Save, as in picture 3.14.

Step 11:

  • The dialog closes and the grid is still in edit.
  • Nothing is saved (leave with Cancel and Discard Changes).
